prompt: What theorems and formal results about exchangeability or hierarchical models are documented in my vault?

assertions.name: cites_specific_sources
assertions.description: Answer references specific vault notes and/or raw PDF files with page numbers or section references

assertions.name: structured_answer_format
assertions.description: Answer uses structured format with Summary, Details, Sources table, and Related Notes sections

assertions.name: identifies_gaps
assertions.description: Answer mentions what information is missing or could be improved in the vault
